description: One API's artifacts grouped by type (by_type_counts is the full summary); pass `type` to scope the list to one type (synonym-aware: MCP matches MCPServer), include=["content"] to inline the bodies.

aid.description: API id in the form provider:api-slug, as find_apis returns it, e.g. "stripe:stripe-api".

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include.description: Pass ["content"] to inline each artifact's body instead of just its URL.

type.description: Return only artifacts of this type.

name: get_api_artifacts
